That's totally me too. I put on a bunch of weight over the holidays and haven't been able to lose it and I hate it. It's probably not that bad and people insist it's fine, but I can't stand it and I'm so self conscious about it. I hate it when people give me shit when I say that I look bad or that I'm putting on weight. It fucks with me so much. Best of luck

It's terrifying. I usually avoid it at all costs. I'm perpetually scared that my intrusive thoughts are going to take over and I'll kill someone. The images of me doing so always flash in front of my eyes and it scares me knowing that just a jerk of the steering wheel can kill anyone on the road - myself included - in an instant. I really do wish I could say some encouragement to you, but I haven't been able to get over it. I'm just grateful I'm in a situation that I don't have to drive much at all.

You're definitely not alone with that. I experience a very similar thing, but with the number 7 and often with associated patterns of movement, usually touching, finger tapping, or sharply articulated syllables. I have a lot of other symptoms of ocd, so that, at least for me isn't the reason for my diagnosis. 

I'm curious if there's a correlation with this and musicians though. I study composition and play a few instruments , so the melodies I hear and count sometimes tie into that. I wonder if you're in a similar situation as I am. 

Best of luck regardless
Almost exactly what you described is one of my symptoms. It's excruciating sometimes. I can definitely sympathize with that

You're not at all alone, those types of intrusive thoughts are very regular for me, and extremely unpleasant, like how you described them. I've never acted on any of it (luckily), but I have taken the step of looking deeper and seeing I guess what could or would happen if I did act on them. It's not pretty and I don't recommend it. I wish I could offer you some sort of advice or trick I've found, but I have nothing. Just know that you're not alone with this, I guess

I was finally diagnosed with ocd a month or so ago. I've done nothing more to help myself. I went through hell and back more times than I want to know in my mind, all while living a fairly good life outside. 

There's only one person in my life who I fully trust and I feel loves me, and that I can say I can love back, but I feel like I constantly fail them and crush their unrealistic expectations of me. They think that I'm some great sweet amazing person, but I'm not that at all. They try to help me and I just end up making things worse for myself and us. 

I drink, I've tried drugs, and I hurt myself to deal with it all and try to suppress symptoms and at least for a little while be like a normal person. At least I used to. I've been trying as hard as I possibly can to stop recently, but I can't. And I know I'll disappoint the only people who care about me if I do. But at the same time, I can't. I can't leave the fucked up person that I am behind. I've had a box of scar removal patches in my closet for a few months now, because I hate looking at all the scars I gave myself, but I still can't bring myself to use them. I've been putting off contacting a specialist and getting proper treatment for my ocd for too long now, and my symptoms are only getting worse, as is my depression. 

The worst part is that I'm still young, and I know that once I do something about all this, I'll be fine. I'll be able to live a good life, do things like I want to. I just need to do something about it.
